title: Science and Education matched-pair persona experiment
purpose: Measure whether a single controlled MatrAIx dimension changes how a user expresses the same frozen Odysseys science-and-education need, while both arms preserve every original rubric requirement.

pairing_controls: Use the same original task, persona model, CUA model, judge model, prompts, runtime limits, and replicate identifier for both arms.
Within a pair, change exactly one MatrAIx dimension value; all other rendered persona dimensions and the display name remain identical.
Keep original task requirements hard: a persona pole may change emphasis, ordering or what it additionally asks for, but may not remove, weaken or contradict any R1-Rn requirement.
Seed both arms' isolated Chrome profiles from the identical warm cookie template, so neither arm starts from a different browser state.
invalid_pair_conditions: Either arm fails to communicate 100% of the original task rubric items.
Either arm scores below 2 for its assigned pole.
The two arms' cited utterances do not show meaningfully opposite preferences.
A pole is detectable only by the absence of a behaviour rather than by an affirmative utterance.
design.axis_selection_note: Seven candidate dimensions were screened against the real simulator prompt before this set was fixed (see the suite README). On this task set only cog_detail_orientation separated strongly; cog_directness separated on the long field-rich tasks only; decision_style separated weakly. Pairs that do not separate are reported as non-separating under the scoring policy rather than dropped.

scoring.evidence_unit: An exact or tightly paraphrased simulated-user utterance, not a CUA action or answer.

per_arm_scale.0: No supporting behavior, a direct contradiction, or behavior that violates a hard task requirement.
per_arm_scale.1: Weak or ambiguous support, including merely repeating language inherited from the original task.
per_arm_scale.2: Clear task-specific expression beyond inherited task wording, with no contradictory user behavior.

scoring.binary_adherence_rule: expressed=true if and only if the per-arm score is 2.
scoring.pair_separation_rule: A matched pair separates only when both arms score 2 for their assigned poles and the cited evidence shows meaningfully opposite preferences or behavior.
scoring.coverage_guardrail: Both arms must communicate 100% of the original task rubrics; otherwise report the pair as invalid rather than treating omission as persona expression.
reporting: Report positive-arm adherence, negative-arm adherence, and pair separation separately by axis and task.
Keep task success and CUA alignment separate; never average them into persona adherence.
Retain the cited utterance, score, confidence, task ID, profile hash, model identities, and replicate identifier for auditability.

positive.behavioral_definition: Requests task-relevant detail beyond the minimum required fields and wants nuanced distinctions preserved.
generic_observables: Asks for at least one relevant optional field or caveat beyond task minimums.
Requests precise identifying detail such as dates, titles, roles, or qualifiers.
Wants the reasoning behind a selection, not just the result.
contradictions: Explicitly asks for only the minimum required fields.
Rejects relevant supporting detail as unnecessary.

negative.behavioral_definition: Wants only the task's required fields and a compact answer, without optional detail.
generic_observables: Explicitly asks the assistant to stick to the required fields only.
Declines optional background or caveats once the task is satisfied.
Prioritises a compact summary over explanatory depth.
contradictions: Requests multiple optional fields or an expanded rationale.
Asks for exhaustive detail beyond the task.

e15345ed27f1933065af403601876e5f6597a943.rationale: The task fixes four artefacts and their identifying fields but says nothing about how much surrounding context the teacher wants, so depth is expressible without touching any requirement.
inherited_task_signals: A 5th-grade grammar quiz with title and URL.
An 8th-grade printable marketing worksheet with title and URL.
A Slidesgo template with name, URL and Google Slides or PowerPoint availability.
The exact lesson intro converted to bionic reading.
positive_observables: Asks for extra identifying detail beyond the required fields, such as roughly how long the quiz runs or what the worksheet actually covers.
Asks why the chosen template suits both the warm-up and the extension, not just that it does.
negative_observables: Asks for just the title, URL and availability for each item and nothing around them.
Says a compact list is preferred over notes explaining the choices.

6421b906fe97b3799960af31c77f20ff25f756b1.rationale: Six lookups each have a defined minimum field set and obvious optional extras, so wanting more or less around those fields is observable without changing them.
inherited_task_signals: Lewis & Clark representative name, email, phone and anything else listed.
Hunter Silberman Fall 2026 MSW deadline.
IU Kokomo graduate programme list.
Two recruiting UCSF glioblastoma trials with status and location.
ORU student activities director from an ORU page.
EDF Energy salary-review wording.
positive_observables: Asks for optional context beyond the required fields, such as how territories are assigned or what stage each trial is at.
Asks for the programme list to carry enough qualifiers to tell similar entries apart.
negative_observables: Asks for only the named fields per institution and no surrounding description.
Says the brief should stay compact even if that means leaving out context.

4614aa083147e45cbc2977cc8634b9d9db25edfe.rationale: The three schools have defined deliverables and a final recommendation, but nothing fixes how much supporting detail accompanies them.
inherited_task_signals: Maryland Carey materials request route and an upcoming online event with date and time.
Baltimore admissions-meeting scheduling instructions with registration link or contact.
American University PIPS scholarship summary and application form link.
A first-contact recommendation with specific next actions.
positive_observables: Asks for extra qualifying detail around each route, such as what the event format is or what the scholarship's conditions are.
Wants the specific next action spelled out per school rather than summarised.
negative_observables: Asks for the link or contact method per school and nothing further.
Says a short plan is preferred over one with explanation attached.

positive.behavioral_definition: States the request as bare instructions with no softening, framing or explanation of why.
generic_observables: Issues the requirements as flat imperatives without hedging or pleasantries.
Omits rationale and context that would not change what is delivered.
States constraints as conditions rather than as requests.
contradictions: Wraps the request in extended courtesy or apology.
Explains at length why the request is being made.

negative.behavioral_definition: States the same request through softened, hedged phrasing and explains the situation around it.
generic_observables: Frames requirements as things they would appreciate or were hoping for.
Supplies surrounding context for why the work is needed.
Hedges instructions rather than issuing them.
contradictions: Issues bare imperatives with no softening.
Strips all framing and context from the request.

65c9e7d383e015d946572f04512d5aa166a8f015.rationale: Four sequential instructions with fixed sites and a verbatim note give a clear frame in which phrasing can be blunt or hedged while the instruction set is unchanged.
inherited_task_signals: Bing search and the top three first-page organic results, opened in tabs.
A Google-found page showing the full ChatGPT prompt template wording.
The 10015.io bionic conversion left visible.
A free plagiarism checker opened live.
positive_observables: Issues the four steps as bare numbered instructions with no framing about why the study note is needed.
States the tab and visibility conditions flatly rather than as requests.
negative_observables: Explains the studying situation the request comes out of before listing what is needed.
Phrases the steps as things they would appreciate rather than as instructions.

6421b906fe97b3799960af31c77f20ff25f756b1.rationale: Six separate lookups with named fields make the difference between flat instruction and hedged request visible across a long message without altering any field.
inherited_task_signals: Lewis & Clark representative for San Diego.
Hunter Silberman Fall 2026 MSW deadline.
IU Kokomo graduate programme list.
Two recruiting UCSF glioblastoma trials.
ORU student activities director from an ORU page.
EDF Energy salary-review wording.
positive_observables: Lists the six institutions as flat directives with no explanation of the student's situation.
States the tab and sourcing conditions as requirements rather than preferences.
negative_observables: Sets out the student's circumstances and why each institution is of interest before the asks.
Softens each institutional lookup into a hope rather than an instruction.

976970ff5d37116847b8a9351a0922196bee88a2.rationale: A sensitive topic gives natural room for hedged framing, while the required sources and quote stay fixed.
inherited_task_signals: A peer-reviewed source on adolescent onset with exact quote and citation detail.
Credible sources on post-childhood brain development and evolutionary influence on cognitive bias.
At least five song titles from the Wikipedia album page.
One chosen title tied to the evidence.
positive_observables: States the three source requirements and the track-list requirement as a bare list.
Gives no framing about the workshop or the audience beyond what the deliverable needs.
negative_observables: Explains the workshop setting and why the evidence matters before asking.
Phrases the citation and quote requirements as things they are hoping for.

positive.behavioral_definition: Wants choices derived from stated, comparable criteria that can be inspected and challenged.
generic_observables: Asks for the options to be set against each other on named factors before a choice is made.
Asks what would change the conclusion.
Wants the reasoning behind a selection made explicit rather than implied.
contradictions: Asks for a single pick with no basis given.
Declines a comparison as unnecessary detail.

negative.behavioral_definition: Wants one confident, well-judged choice and a short reason, trusting the assistant's feel for what fits.
generic_observables: Asks the assistant to just pick the one it judges best and say briefly why.
Prefers a decisive answer over a worked comparison.
Signals that a clear next move matters more than seeing the weighing.
contradictions: Demands an explicit criteria table before accepting a choice.
Rejects a recommendation solely because the alternatives were not enumerated.

8c30f2f9ceeac75b05c725c5397022bb4f9d32a0.task_label: Choosing categories and the hardware tie-back
8c30f2f9ceeac75b05c725c5397022bb4f9d32a0.rationale: The task requires selecting at least three of IBM's categories and then connecting a hardware example back to AI, so the basis for those two choices is observable.
inherited_task_signals: Selecting at least three categories and rewriting them in one plain sentence each.
Connecting the Granite Rapids example back to why strong chips matter for AI.
Producing one combined beginner write-up.
positive_observables: Asks for the basis on which those particular three categories were picked, in terms a beginner-ordering argument can be checked against.
Asks for the chip-to-AI connection to be stated as an explicit reason rather than left implied.
negative_observables: Asks the assistant to pick whichever three categories read most naturally first for a beginner and not belabour the choice.
Wants the hardware tie-back to read as a natural closing line rather than a justified step.

4614aa083147e45cbc2977cc8634b9d9db25edfe.task_label: Which Maryland/DC law school to contact first
4614aa083147e45cbc2977cc8634b9d9db25edfe.rationale: The task ends in an explicit recommendation across three schools with different outreach and funding options, which is exactly where decision style shows.
inherited_task_signals: Finding the Maryland Carey request route and an upcoming online admissions event with date and time.
Finding the Baltimore admissions-meeting scheduling instructions and registration link or contact.
Summarising the American University PIPS scholarship and its application form link.
Recommending which school to contact first with a specific next action for each.
positive_observables: Asks for the three schools to be set against each other on comparable factors before the recommendation is given.
Asks what would change the ranking, for example if the event date or the funding route did not work out.
negative_observables: Asks for one confident pick with a short reason rather than a side-by-side comparison.
Says a clear first move matters more than seeing how the three were weighed.

976970ff5d37116847b8a9351a0922196bee88a2.rationale: The task requires selecting one track from at least five and justifying it against three sources, so the selection method is observable.
inherited_task_signals: Pulling at least five song titles from the album page.
Choosing one title as the best discussion prompt for teens.
Explaining why the chosen title fits the themes from the three sources.
positive_observables: Asks for the chosen title to be checked against the themes of each of the three sources in turn.
Asks which other titles were close and why they were not chosen.
negative_observables: Asks the assistant to go with the title that will land best with teenagers and give a brief reason.
Says a single well-judged pick is preferable to working through the shortlist.
